svg.text: Transformers Reinforcement Learning - huggingface/trl - Post-training on HF Transformers stack
Light wrapper over transformers.Trainer - shared callbacks
Data collators - chat template - checkpoint save/load
Method-specific loss + logging + eval hooks per trainer
Preference pairs - no online generation required
Generate completions - reward_funcs - policy update loop
All trainers: model + dataset + args - trainer.train() - push to Hub
Static dataset - no rollout generation - preference or supervised loss
Step 1: Load model (AutoModelForCausalLM) + tokenizer + optional peft_config
Step 2: Dataset - prompt/completion, chat, or chosen/rejected preference pairs
Step 3: Trainer init - SFTTrainer / DPOTrainer with method-specific Config
Step 4: trainer.train() - CE loss (SFT) or DPO/ORPO/KTO preference objective
Step 5: Checkpoint + Hub push - W&B/TrackIO metrics - repeat epochs
RewardTrainer: train scalar reward model on preference rankings before RLHF
GKD/MiniLLM: teacher-student distillation for model compression
Online RL - model generates its own training data each step
Step 1: Generate N completions per prompt (generate / vLLM / cont. batching)
Step 2: reward_funcs score completions (built-in, RM, or custom callable)
Step 3: Group-relative advantage within prompt batch (no critic model)
Step 4: KL penalty vs ref model + clipped policy loss - backward + optimizer step
Step 5: Sync weights to vLLM colocate engine (if enabled) - next batch - loop
Agentic: environment_factory (OpenEnv / Harbor sandbox + verifier + tools)
L6 - Production & Position in HF Stack
CUDA GPU / multi-node - TRL v1 full-stack post-training - between Datasets and deployed models on Hub
Init path: trl CLI or Trainer() - load model/dataset - Accelerate prepare - optional vLLM engine init
Step path: batch - (generate+reward for online) - loss - backward - log - checkpoint - repeat
Sources: huggingface/trl - docs/trl - TRL v1 blog 2026-03 - GRPOTrainer docs - OpenEnv/Harbor integration
